nodes.description: DSAuth.owner: privileged address that passes the auth modifier
DSAuth.authority: DSAuthority contract consulted for authorization
DSStop.stopped: halts poke via the stoppable modifier
OSM.src: external DSValue oracle contract whose peek() is called by poke
OSM.hop: delay in seconds between allowed poke calls and modulo base in prev
OSM.zzz: truncated timestamp of the last update, used in pass()
OSM.cur: current Feed value exposed by peek/read
OSM.nxt: next Feed value exposed by peep and promoted to cur
OSM.ONE_HOUR: constant default hop value of 3600 seconds
DSAuth.isAuthorized(address,bytes4): resolves authorization for the auth modifier
DSAuth.setOwner(address): privileged owner update guarded by auth
DSAuth.setAuthority(DSAuthority): privileged authority update guarded by auth
DSStop.stop(): auth+note guarded function setting stopped = true
DSStop.start(): auth+note guarded function setting stopped = false
OSM.era(): internal view returning block.timestamp
OSM.prev(uint): truncates a timestamp to a multiple of hop
OSM.step(uint16): auth guarded update of hop
OSM.void(): auth guarded reset of cur/nxt and permanent stop
OSM.pass(): view returning era() >= zzz + hop
OSM.poke(): stoppable external entry point that pulls a value from src and shifts cur/nxt
OSM.peek(): view returning current value and validity flag
OSM.peep(): view returning next value and validity flag
OSM.read(): view returning current value, requiring cur.has
OSM constructor(DSValue): sets src and seeds cur/nxt/zzz from src.peek()
DSAuth constructor(): sets owner from msg.sender and emits LogSetOwner
Caller address used as owner, as isAuthorized source and as event field
Miner-controlled timestamp consumed by era(), pass() and prev()
External call src.peek() made inside poke/constructor before state finalization
External call authority.canCall(src,this,sig) executed during authorization
Unchecked arithmetic ts - (ts % hop) inside prev(uint)
Unchecked arithmetic zzz + hop inside pass()
uint128(wut) truncating cast applied to the oracle return value
src argument of isAuthorized(address src, bytes4 sig)
sig argument of isAuthorized(address src, bytes4 sig)
owner_ argument of setOwner(address owner_)
authority_ argument of setAuthority(DSAuthority authority_)
ts argument of step(uint16 ts) written into hop
ts argument of prev(uint ts) used in the modulo subtraction
src_ argument of the OSM constructor, assigned to src and peeked
wut local in poke holding the raw oracle value
ok local in poke holding the oracle validity flag
wut local in the OSM constructor holding the raw oracle value
ok local in the OSM constructor holding the oracle validity flag
